title: RCT on Necessity of Cholecystectomy for Patients After Clearance of Bile Duct Stones
brief_summary: To discuss necessity of cholecystectomy for patients with stones in their bile ducts and gallbladders in the absence of absolute operation indications of cholecystectomy after clearance of bile duct stones with ERCP.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Obtention of a written informed consent; Clinical diagnosis of gallbladder stones and common bile duct stones; No absolute operation indications of cholecystectomy

Exclusion Criteria:

Intrahepatic stones; Malignant tumor disease ;
